contracts.signal: Horizon Quantum (20-F): on March 31, 2026 it entered a Quantum Systems Agreement with IonQ under which IonQ will design, procure, install, verify and support a dedicated trapped-ion quantum computing system in a data center designated and operated by Horizon (title transfers on acceptance) and provide compute, consulting, training and technical support, primarily on an on-site and exclusive basis; total consideration under the initial statement of work is US$35 million, with an optional one-year extension.

players.product: Triple Alpha quantum software development environment (hardware-agnostic compiler / deployment), run on an in-house quantum hardware testbed

quarterly_data.signal: Horizon Quantum (20-F): its Triple Alpha integrated development environment is in early access with select vendors; Horizon has received inbound early-access interest from more than 40 major corporations, 90 universities, 13 quantum software companies and 18 national labs, government agencies and research organizations.

Horizon Quantum (20-F): owns and operates a superconducting quantum computer (its on-site testbed) and plans to make it available to Triple Alpha users in the first half of 2026; it anticipates an additional S$0.79 million (US$0.61 million) of testbed investment, bringing the total to S$3.41 million (US$2.63 million).
